title: Fiza — Verification-Gated Human-AI Co-Development for the Environment (Scaffold)
description: Fiza (air/atmosphere/environment) is the environmental replica of VGC-Health: a research proposal to let environmental scientists, practitioners and communities contribute to a shared, verification-gated environmental knowledge manifold without writing code, by retargeting the Verification-Gated Human-AI Co-Development (VGC) method from clinic to climate and ecology. Sprint 0 scaffold; the full paper is built incrementally. Part of the Zistgah ecosystem; element-named sibling of zamin (earth) and aab (water).
